critical_code_review_comments: Scripts.jsx is now 1397 lines — already flagged in prev iterations, still recommended to split into a hook (useScriptEngine) + smaller view components. The new toggles + streaming logic add ~100 lines and the file is firmly past the 700-line threshold.

server.py _run_script_job() imports emergentintegrations inside the function (line 2216) on every job invocation. Minor: hoist to module top-level for a tiny speedup and to fail-fast at boot if the package is missing.

_run_script_job() ignores StreamDone.usage / cost metadata — if you later want to log per-script token spend for cost monitoring, capture StreamDone.usage and write to db.scripts.{prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost_usd}.

Throttle write interval (0.25s) is fine for short scripts but for long-length renders that take ~5min, the throttle still produces ~1200 writes — consider also bounding writes by minimum delta-bytes (e.g. only write if accumulated grew by >50 chars OR 250ms elapsed).

BuyersTab.jsx Add buyer modal makes N sequential PATCH calls (one per entitlement). For 3 entitlements that's 3 round-trips. Acceptable for an admin tool but could be a single 'create-buyer' endpoint that accepts entitlements[] in one call.
